tools.name: review_repository
tools.description: Start here for an unfamiliar repository or a general test-architecture review. Detect and audit all project roots once, then return a bounded deterministic review: summary counts, blockers, top findings, the top-ranked candidates and plan items with execution hints, verification commands, and stats. limit caps the ranked lists (default 25) and per-test evidence is reduced to counts, so the result stays small on large monorepos. Use explain_target with repoRoot and projectRoot for one target's evidence, and analyze_repository only when the complete bundle is explicitly needed.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before the review.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root when several schemes declare a test action. Keys are detected project roots.

limit.description: Maximum ranked candidates and plan items to return. Defaults to 25.

tools.title: Review Repository

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/repository-review-v1.schema.json in the published package.

tools.name: analyze_repository
tools.description: Return the complete repository-analysis/v1 bundle: every project audit with per-target test evidence plus the derived summary, findings, ranking, plan, execution hints, and stats. The result grows with repository size and can exceed client limits on large monorepos, so prefer review_repository first and use this only when the complete bundle is explicitly needed or the repository is small.
